2607.14898.title: FlashDecoder: Real-Time Latent-to-Pixel Streaming Decoder with Transformers
2607.14898.paper_summary: Real-time video generation demands fast decoding as much as fast denoising, yet current latent video diffusion models rely on 3D convolutional decoders that are slow and memory-intensive at high resolutions or for long video. We introduce FlashDecoder, a fast, memory-efficient pure-Transformer video decoder that decodes latents to pixels frame by frame. At each step, the current frame attends only to a fixed-size window of past frames through a rolling KV cache. The fixed temporal window keeps decoding fast and memory bounded regardless of video length, enabling constant-latency streaming. Because frames are processed sequentially, temporal causality is enforced without explicit attention masks, enabling training at resolutions up to 1080p and matching the reconstruction quality of convolutional decoders. On the Wan2.1 and Wan2.2 latent spaces, FlashDecoder matches each convolutional decoder in reconstruction quality (e.g., 41.55dB vs. 41.49dB PSNR at 1080p) while decoding 3.6x-4.7x faster with up to 11x less memory on a single H100 GPU. With architecture-aware inference optimizations, the speedup widens to 12x.
2607.14898.paper_summary_zh: 實時視頻生成需要快速解碼和快速去噪，然而當前的潛在視頻擴散模型依賴於在高解析度或長視頻下速度緩慢且內存密集的3D卷積解碼器。我們介紹了FlashDecoder，一種快速、內存高效的純Transformer視頻解碼器，能夠逐幀將潛在數據解碼為像素。在每一步中，當前幀僅通過滾動KV緩存關注過去幀的固定大小窗口。這個固定的時間窗口使得解碼無論視頻長度如何都能保持快速和內存受限，實現恆定延遲的串流。由於幀是按順序處理的，時間因果性在沒有明確注意力掩碼的情況下得以強化，使得在高達1080p的解析度下進行訓練成為可能，並且重建質量可與卷積解碼器相媲美。在Wan2.1和Wan2.2潛在空間中，FlashDecoder在重建質量上與每個卷積解碼器相匹配（例如，在1080p下41.55dB對41.49dB PSNR），同時在單個H100 GPU上以3.6x-4.7x的速度更快解碼，內存使用量減少最多達11倍。通過架構感知的推理優化，速度提升擴大到12倍。
2607.14898.author: Minguk Kang et.al.
